# Test fixtures for silvermere-rules

## expneeded.json

The experience each level needs, for a range of race and class experience modifiers.
Generated by `tools/parsegen/expneeded.py`; regenerate with
`python3 -I tools/parsegen/expneeded.py --out crates/silvermere-rules/tests/fixtures/expneeded.json`.
`tests/progression.rs` (`exp_needed_matches_the_python_oracle`) reads it.
